latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Creator Free.

- Convert text, DOCX, PDF, or pasted content (up to 500MB) into shareable 1080p MP4 videos.
- Cloud processing with fast turnaround (1-2 minutes); no installation needed.
- Automatic handling of user sessions, tokens, and credits with a free starter tier.
- Supports custom video instructions, file uploads, editing, and exporting in multiple formats.
- Designed for creators wanting to generate videos from text without recording footage.
